the expression of BNP mRNA was decreased in diabetic rats with coronary artery ligation.

the expression of BNP in diabetic rats with and without MI.
the effects of diabetes on cardiac function and BNP gene expression in rats with MI.
the expression of BNP in the diabetic rats with myocardia infarct.

the expression of BNP mRNA is impaired in the diabetic rats with MI.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
diabetes impaired cardiac BNP gene expression in the left ventricular myocardium of diabetic rats with acute MI.
BNP mRNA expression in diabetic rats was decreased in the right ventricle and in the left ventricular myocardium after coronary ligation and insulin therapy restored BNP mRNA expression.
diabetes mellitus attenuates the expression of cardiac BNP gene in rats with MI.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the impaired expression of cardiac BNP in diabetic rats with coronary ligation is not due to the lack of myocardial injury.
the expression of BNP in the diabetic rats with MI is significantly lower than that in nondiabetic rats.
diabetes may impair BNP gene expression in the heart.
